package handler

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"GENRE_MODULE/game/scenarionet"
	bots "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest"
	generated "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest/protocol"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/gateway"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/action"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/protocol"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/runner"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/session"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
)

func TestScenarioRobotCompleteCoopAndClientViews(t *testing.T) {
	f := newScenario(t)
	RegisterCoopViewHandlersNestHandlers()
	auth := gateway.AuthenticatorFunc(func(_ context.Context, token string, _ net.Addr) (gateway.Principal, error) {
		id := f.outsider.ID()
		switch token {
		case "first":
			id = f.players[0].ID()
		case "second":
			id = f.players[1].ID()
		case "outsider":
		default:
			return gateway.Principal{}, gateway.ErrUnauthenticated
		}
		return gateway.Principal{PlayerID: id, SessionID: token, ServerID: 1}, nil
	})
	cfg := gateway.DefaultTCPConfig()
	cfg.Addr = "127.0.0.1:0"
	server, err := gateway.NewTCPServer(cfg, scenarionet.CoopDispatch(f.engine), auth)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = server.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if err := server.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	ticket := func(token string) robot.AuthProvider {
		return func(*robot.Context) (*transport.Packet, error) { return transport.AuthPacket(token), nil }
	}
	run := bots.Coop(runner.Config{Duration: 10 * time.Second, Transport: transport.Config{Endpoint: server.Addr().String()}}, f.room.ID(), [2]robot.AuthProvider{ticket("first"), ticket("second")})
	if err = run.Run(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if s := run.Stats(); s.Success != 1 || s.Failure != 0 || s.Canceled != 0 {
		t.Fatal(s)
	}
	var rejected int64
	for _, m := range run.MessageReport().Messages {
		rejected += m.Rejected
		if m.Inflight != 0 || m.Timeout != 0 || m.Errors != 0 {
			t.Fatal(m)
		}
	}
	if rejected != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("business refusals not recorded: %d", rejected)
	}
	if run.TrafficReport().MeasuredConnections != 4 {
		t.Fatal(run.TrafficReport())
	}
	registry := protocol.NewRegistry(nil)
	generated.RegisterDefaults(registry)
	outsider := robot.NewContext(robot.Config{Transport: transport.Config{Type: transport.PlayerTCPType, Endpoint: server.Addr().String()}, Protocols: registry, Auth: ticket("outsider")})
	defer outsider.Close()
	actions := action.NewRegistry()
	outsider.RunAction = actions.Run
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if err = outsider.Do(ctx, action.NameConnect, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err = bots.CoopView(ctx, outsider, f.room.ID()); !errors.Is(err, session.ErrRejected) {
		t.Fatalf("outsider saw private view: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err = bots.CoopCommand(ctx, outsider, &pb.ScenarioCommandRequest{RoomID: f.room.ID(), Seq: 1, Revision: 8, Kind: "claim"}); !errors.Is(err, session.ErrRejected) {
		t.Fatalf("non-member claimed reward: %v", err)
	}

}
